caption:
Lulu spends all day looking up at ceilings with a roller, and by knock-off time her neck and shoulders feel like concrete.

Holding your arms up and your head tipped back for ages can leave the neck and shoulders tight. An extension pole and mixing up your tasks can ease the load.

Hybi's painter tips: use an extension pole for ceilings, alternate ceiling and wall work, and do a few big shoulder rolls between coats. Remedial massage may help tight neck and shoulder muscles feel easier.

Arm tingling, weakness or trouble lifting your arm is worth an assessment first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD remedial massage therapists can help. Book online via the link in bio
